evals.prompt: Our payment module has a flaky timeout test. Establish a baseline, add a regression test for the race condition, fix it, and verify.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs baseline checks, discovers the race condition boundary, adds a deterministic failing test first, makes the minimal fix, and re-runs focused and full gates with exact counts and artifacts.
assertions: The response runs and records baseline checks before changes
The response adds a failing regression test before the fix
The response makes the smallest production fix
The response verifies with focused test then full gates with counts

evals.prompt: Review this PR for architectural issues.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes the request to architecture-review or code-review rather than running a QA loop.
assertions: The response identifies architecture-review or code-review as closer workflow
The response does not run a QA hardening loop for a review request

evals.expected_output: The agent asks for the specific scope, risk boundary, and whether the user wants test-only coverage or production fixes with approval.
assertions: The response requests the specific scope and risk boundary
The response clarifies S/M/high-risk approval gate
The response does not change production code without approval
